# Aditum

> Aditum is an open-access academic publishing platform hosting peer-reviewed journals across medicine, business, and computer science with transparent editorial processes.

Aditum Publishing LLC operates a collection of open-access journals covering diverse disciplines including cardiology, nephrology, business research, and mathematics. All content is published under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License, ensuring broad accessibility and reusability for the global research community.

## Key Topics

- Open-Access Publishing
- Peer-Reviewed Journals
- Article In Press

- Manuscript Submission
- Cardiology Research

## Featured Journals

- [Cardiology Research and Cardiovascular Interventions](https://www.aditum.org/journals/cardiology-research-and-cardiovascular-interventions/editorial-board): Editorial board for Cardiology Research and Cardiovascular Interventions journal
- [Cardiology Interventions](https://www.aditum.org/journals/cardiology-interventions/article-in-press): Articles in press for Cardiology Interventions journal
- [Nephrology and Renal Care](https://www.aditum.org/journals/nephrology-and-renal-care/editorial-board): Editorial board for Nephrology and Renal Care journal
- [International Journal of Business Research and Management](https://www.aditum.org/journals/international-journal-of-business-research-and-management/article-in-press/1102): Article in press for International Journal of Business Research and Management
- [International Mathematics and Computer Science](https://www.aditum.org/journals/international-mathematics-and-computer-science/article-in-press): Articles in press for International Mathematics and Computer Science
